subject: Inaugural onboarding cadence & ownership docket — Helios Health
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@helios.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Inaugural onboarding cadence & ownership docket — Helios Health

Claire —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Per our call, attached is a first-pass onboarding cadence I put together (attached as Helios-MAP-v1.xlsx). It includes the high-level milestones we discussed and suggested owners. Key points summarized below: 

- Kickoff: target Dec 1, 2026 — 60 minute call to align stakeholders and confirm acceptance criteria
- Milestone 1 (Provisioning): Dec 3–Dec 7 — Redwood infra & Helios network signoff (owner: Naomi)
- Milestone 2 (Model Validation): Dec 8–Dec 14 — test traffic & quality signoff (owner: Marissa)
- Milestone 3 (SLA Cutover): Dec 15 — production route switch and smoke tests (owner: Aditya)

Ask: can you confirm who from your side will own procurement and security evidence? I’ve left placeholders in the workbook for the procurement PO and the security contact. We’ll also need the PO and a quick SOW review to get the contract in motion — I can circulate a draft SOW if that helps.

Proposed next step: 30–45m kickoff on Dec 1 (10:00 PT) — does that work for you and Raj?

Attachments: Helios-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Cheers,

Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first platform for predictable LLM inference
From: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@helios.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@helios.ai>, procurement@helios.ai
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2026 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Inaugural onboarding cadence & ownership docket — Helios Health

Thanks, Aditya — this looks good and aligns with our internal timeline. Two quick notes: 

1) Procurement: looping in procurement@helios.ai (copied) — they want an initial SOW draft and estimated run rates so they can start the PO.
2) Security: can you add a security evidence column (SOC2/retention/audit logs) to the MAP? Our security reviewer (Raj) will need that to sign off; I’ve included him on the thread.

Dec 1 kickoff at 10:00 PT works for us. Please send a calendar invite. If you can attach a short SOW stub we can begin review.

Appreciate it,

Claire Johnson
Head of Partnerships | Helios Health
claire.johnson@helios.ai | +1 (619) 555-2233

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Helios kickoff ownership + security evidence lane

Marissa / Naomi —

Looping you both in to scope ownership and quick responsibilities so Claire and procurement have a single point of contact on our side. Summary of what I’d like each of you to take: 

- Marissa Cole (Customer Success lead): owner for acceptance criteria, test plans for model quality, stakeholder communications (tickets --> closure). Lead on-site kickoff and weekly ops calls.
- Naomi Feldman (Onboarding/Infra engineer): owner for networking, VPC peering, keys, environment provisioning, and smoke-test signoff. Work with Helios security to supply SOC2 artifacts and log retention details.

I attached the MAP I sent to Claire and a very rough SOW stub (SOW-Helios-v0.2.pdf) — please review the milestone dates and call out any blockers or capacity conflicts by EOD Friday. I’ll coordinate procurement questions with Claire’s procurement team.

Quick checklist for you both: 
- Confirm ability to meet Dec 1 kickoff
- Call out any additional security evidence they’ll need (I’ve already added a column in the sheet)
- Confirm owners for each line item and sign off on acceptance criteria

HubSpot deal: HS-4129 (I’ve left the deal in Discovery > Next steps).

Thanks — I’ll send the calendar invite after Claire confirms procurement contact.

Aditya
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@helios.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helios.ai
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Inaugural onboarding cadence & ownership docket — Helios Health (finalized MAP & SOW stub)

Claire / team —

Thanks — confirming the mutual action plan and owners below. I updated the attached MAP with the security evidence column and embedded acceptance criteria inline. I also attached a short SOW stub for procurement to review.

Finalized milestones / owners / acceptance criteria (short):

1) Kickoff — Dec 1, 2026, 10:00 PT (Owners: Aditya / Claire / Marissa)
   - Agenda: introductions, milestone walk, acceptance criteria signoff, next steps
2) Environment Provisioning — Dec 3–Dec 7 (Owner: Naomi)
   - Acceptance: VPC peering validated, test API reachable from Helios CIDR, KMS keys provisioned
3) Model Validation & Traffic Replay — Dec 8–Dec 14 (Owner: Marissa)
   - Acceptance: sample traffic runs, latency within target (p90 <= 180ms), quality smoke tests pass on 3 prompt sets
4) Production Cutover (SLA go-live) — Dec 15 (Owners: Aditya / Naomi)
   - Acceptance: Route flip complete, rollback procedure tested, monitoring alerts in place

Attachments included: Helios-MAP-v1.xlsx, SOW-Helios-v0.2.pdf
DocuSign SOW link: https://docusign.com/embeddedSigning/XXXX-Helios-SOW
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-4129

Next actions (what I’ll do this week):
- Send Dec 1 calendar invite (10:00 PT) with short agenda and join details
- Naomi will circulate the network checklist and temporary test credentials by Dec 2
- Aditya to work with procurement on SOW and PO collection

Claire — please confirm procurement has what they need and flag any internal dependencies. If all good I’ll kick the DocuSign flow after the kickoff.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (212) 555-0077
